entities.summary: The Château du Champ de Bataille is a château located in the Eure department of the French region of Upper Normandy. It is a Baroque château lying between the communes of Neubourg and Sainte-Opportune-du-Bosc, and in the Campagne du Neubourg, between the river Risle to the west and the river Iton to the east. It was built in the 17th century for the Maréchal de Créqui.
